| Model | Tuning Mean | Lockbox Mean | Worst MDD |
|-------|-------------|--------------|-----------|
| **Champion** (v5_latest) | 1.904 | 1.793 | -9.31% |
| Last PASS Candidate | 1.762 | 1.793 | -11.18% |

## Key Observations

1. **Champion holds** - The `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` candidate matched lockbox mean but has worse drawdown characteristics (-11.2% vs -9.3%)

2. **Trade-off noted** - Candidate shows better lockbox minimum (1.35 vs 1.13), suggesting more consistent out-of-sample performance, but at cost of deeper drawdowns

3. **No blocking issues** - INCONCLUSIVE queue is clear

## Next Steps

The three commands are ready to execute in sequence:

```bash
# 1. Run module-level experiments and select best
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level candidate experiments  
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate next-fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

---

**Action needed?** Should I proceed with running these commands, or would you like analysis on a specific aspect (e.g., why the macro_alpha_shadow candidate didn't beat champion on MDD)?
